[USER] User loves pineapple and avocado.  
[USER] User is interested in improving digestion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The digestive system absorbs nutrients from food through several steps, starting in the mouth with chewing and mixing with saliva.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Enzymes in saliva begin to break down carbohydrates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Food travels down the esophagus into the stomach, where it is mixed with enzymes and gastric juices that break down proteins.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In the small intestine, more enzymes from the pancreas and small intestine break down proteins, carbohydrates, and fats into smaller molecules like amino acids, glucose, and fatty acids.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These smaller molecules are absorbed into the bloodstream through the walls of the small intestine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Enzymes are catalysts that speed up chemical reactions, making digestion and absorption of nutrients more efficient.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Without enzymes, the body cannot break down food into absorbable nutrients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Foods rich in enzymes include pineapple (bromelain), papaya (papain), mango (amylase), avocado (lipase), and fermented foods (sauerkraut, kimchi, miso).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eating foods rich in enzymes can support digestion, but the body also produces its own enzymes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some enzymes may be destroyed during cooking and processing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for improving digestion include eating slowly and mindfully, eating a varied and balanced diet, staying hydrated, managing stress, exercising regularly, limiting processed foods and added sugars, and considering probiotics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If experiencing persistent digestive issues, it's best to speak with a healthcare professional.  
[USER] User plans to incorporate more probiotics into their diet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When looking for probiotic supplements or yogurt, consider choosing a reputable brand, checking the expiration date, looking for high CFU counts, and specific strains like Lactobacillus acidophilus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular probiotic supplement brands include Garden of Life, Renew Life, and Culturelle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended yogurt brands include Stonyfield and Chobani, ensuring they contain live and active cultures.  
[USER] User is interested in healthy, easy-to-digest snacks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Healthy, easy-to-digest snack ideas include fresh fruit, yogurt, smoothies, hummus and veggies, rice cakes with nut butter, hard-boiled eggs, and soups.
